existing.program_type: In most circumstances, students who receive OSAP are Canadian citizens, Permanent Residents, or a Protected Person and thus would not be eligible for the International Student Entrance Scholarship.

scholarships.title: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship—Master's (CGRS-M)
scholarships.official_source: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC)

existing.description: The Canada Graduate Research Scholarship-Master's program provides financial support to high-calibre scholars who are engaged in an eligible master's or, in some cases, doctoral programme in Canada, allowing them to concentrate more fully on their studies in their chosen fields. For the December 2026 competition SSHRC publishes an application deadline of December 1, 2026 (8:00 p.m. eastern) and a value and duration of $27,000 for 1 year. The award is one of the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship competitions run through the federal research agencies, and SSHRC's page lists associated supplements and joint initiatives separately from the core award.
eligibility: Enrolled in an eligible master's programme in Canada
Doctoral programme applicants may be eligible in some cases, per the official wording
Applications are submitted to SSHRC, which is one of the three federal research agencies running the Canada Graduate Research Scholarship program
existing.eligibility_summary: The programme funds high-calibre scholars engaged in an eligible master's, or in some cases doctoral, programme in Canada. It is a research training award open through SSHRC as one of the three federal research agencies.
benefits: Can be held at any eligible Canadian university
To maintain eligibility for MINDS Scholarship Initiative funding, award and supplement holders’ research must remain within the priority areas of the MINDS Policy Challenges .
Reporting requirements for each funding stream will be outlined in the notice of award and letter of offer.
Applicants must select the “Indigenous Scholars Awards and Supplements Pilot Initiative” option from the drop-down menu in the “Supplements/Joint Initiatives” section of the application form.
Eligible applicants who receive an offer of award through the CGRS D or CPRA funding opportunity may be considered for an Indigenous Scholars Supplement to the limit of available funding.
coverage: To maintain eligibility for MINDS Scholarship Initiative funding, award and supplement holders’ research must remain within the priority areas of the MINDS Policy Challenges .
requirements: Application through CIHR, NSERC, or SSHRC portal
Research proposal aligned with agency mandate

application_method: Submit the application to SSHRC for the December competition

existing.selection_notes: Merit-based; evaluated by agency-specific peer review committees.
existing.best_fit: High-calibre master's students seeking research funding across all disciplines.
existing.notes: Replaces the former CGS-M program under the harmonized CRTAS suite. International students are eligible through all three agencies.
